title: When you are afraid or anxious
line: For worry, dread, a racing mind.
intro: Fear narrows everything. A longer out-breath tells the body it is safe enough, and an old prayer for courage reminds the mind that it is not alone.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Breathe in for four, and out for six: a longer out-breath calms the body. If counting is too much, simply follow the circle.

steps.title: A prayer against fear
steps.text: The great prayer to Shiva for release from fear: as a ripe fruit falls freely from its stem, may I be freed.

steps.title: Call on strength
steps.text: Repeat AUM Sri Hanumate Namaha, Hanuman’s name, steadily.

steps.title: What is in my hands
steps.prompt: What is one thing within my control today, however small?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: If anxiety is with you most days, you deserve more than a practice: please talk to a doctor or counsellor. Tele-MANAS is free on 14416.
